name: ゴキブリの乳に仰天、鼻の「フンッ」に納得(再制作版・最新仕様)

p_c520513e91.sentence: You laugh at the names, then lean in as you hear the story.
p_c520513e91.prev: But both were subjects of research featured in this year’s Ig Nobel Prize.
p_c520513e91.next: So, first, let’s go inside a cockroach’s belly.

p_f28d1fd6e5.sentence: The subject suddenly feels much closer to home, but even our everyday “Pff!”
p_f28d1fd6e5.prev: From a cockroach’s belly to the tissue in your hand.
p_f28d1fd6e5.next: can become a serious research topic when scientists look at it.

p_b9e7e55fe0.sentence: First, cockroach milk makes our eyes go wide.
p_b9e7e55fe0.prev: Even something we do without thinking can give us a real clue.
p_b9e7e55fe0.next: Then we find ourselves wondering about the two sides of our own nose.

p_020e2d81ef.sentence: They studied one species of cockroach that carries its young inside its body and gives birth to them.
p_020e2d81ef.prev: The Chemistry Prize went to researchers who studied the protein in cockroach milk.
p_020e2d81ef.next: The mother produces liquid milk, and her young drink it inside her belly.

p_927b3e2407.sentence: The milk they drank led to crystals.
p_927b3e2407.prev: The researchers extracted crystals of milk protein that had formed in the gut of the young.
p_927b3e2407.next: What’s more, the paper estimated that a single crystal held more than three times as much energy as the same weight of milk from dairy products.

p_8a1f73e966.sentence: The frown on our faces at the word “cockroach” soon turns into, “How does that work?”
p_8a1f73e966.prev: That is a very big number for a tiny crystal.
p_8a1f73e966.next: Now the next stage is right in the middle of our own faces.

p_17963bb818.sentence: The study found that when one nostril was easier to breathe through than the other, holding the more open side shut made the air coming out of the less open side move faster.
p_17963bb818.next: The authors explain that this is a reason to blow one nostril at a time in such cases.

p_507c461a68.sentence: What seemed like a strange story from a far-off world turned out to connect to us the next time we reach for a tissue.
p_507c461a68.prev: We laugh at “what they studied” and think about “what they found.”
p_507c461a68.next: This prize makes us laugh, then keeps us thinking.

p_322a48f101.sentence: The researchers extracted crystals of milk protein that had formed in the gut of the young.
p_322a48f101.prev: It is surprising enough that it produces milk, but the story gets even more surprising from here.
p_322a48f101.next: The milk they drank led to crystals.

p_3b4c0c6565.sentence: The researchers wanted to study the speed and amount of air when people blew their noses, how long it took, and changes in pressure inside the ear.
p_3b4c0c6565.prev: can become a serious research topic when scientists look at it.
p_3b4c0c6565.next: Their aim was to get data that could give specific advice on how to blow your nose.
